title: Fix instruction traceability, hosted evidence schema, and archive path integrity
outOfScope: Implementing the WI-10 installation-document content itself
Changing release.json, next-release.json, release-state.json, or public release identity
Creating tags, GitHub Releases, or publishing provider assets
Weakening required quality, release, SBOM, provenance, or CI evidence gates

sources.reason: Repository workflow requires one Work Item lifecycle, fail-closed evidence, and process-root-cause review.
Records RFE-ISSUE-091 through RFE-ISSUE-095 and the required serial order.
Defines the bidirectional instruction-to-plan-to-implementation-to-acceptance manifest that currently exposed the WI-21 archive-path failure.
Current Summary schema rejected the needed hosted evidence structure.
Current checker does not resolve archived Contract paths after finish.
Archive operation is the source of Contract/Summary/Manifest/index path and digest transitions.
PR #408 failure exposed incomplete dependent-job evidence and misleading diagnostics.
PR #408 entered release-preparation mode from source-bound evidence file changes and emitted incomplete failure evidence.
Regression coverage for registered hosted evidence schema.
Regression coverage for named-path mapping and archive path resolution.
Regression coverage for required dependent-job evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The changes harden fail-closed evidence and release-preparation boundaries; incorrect binding could either block valid work or allow an unverified release path.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized continuous serial execution; implementation remains bounded to the recorded process failures and cannot publish.

preReviewWarnings: Verify that ordinary governance/evidence maintenance changes do not silently enter release-preparation mode.
Verify that failed and skipped dependent CI jobs are represented without weakening required-job validation.
Verify that named paths are never accepted without implementation evidence or explicit no-change rationale.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Every user-named required path is mechanically required to have implementation evidence or an explicit no-change rationale, and the WI-10 installation.md omission remains release-blocking.
A2: Summary schema formally registers structured hosted evidence with scenario, status, reason, source, and comparison-boundary fields; unknown ad-hoc fields remain rejected.
A3: Archive completion updates or resolves traceability paths and synchronizes Contract, Summary, Archive Manifest, and archive index digests; stale paths fail closed.

A4: Release-preparation scope is controlled by explicit Work Item/event intent and does not trigger candidate validation for ordinary evidence-maintenance changes; release Work Items still fail closed.
A5: CI evidence records all required jobs including skipped/dependent jobs and reports missing-job versus head-binding failures distinctly; regression tests cover the PR #408 failure.
A6: All changes pass the full AI/project verification and complete this corrective Work Item's PR, merge, archive, close, and branch-cleanup lifecycle without publishing a release.
guidelines: Preserve fail-closed behavior; do not solve evidence failures by weakening validation.
Keep release identity and public publication out of this corrective Work Item.
Add regression coverage before changing each process boundary.

intent.problem: WI-21 and the prior WI-10 audit demonstrated that the repository can pass local implementation checks while still losing a user-named file mapping, lacking a registered machine-readable hosted-evidence shape, or retaining stale active/archive traceability and digest references. PR #408 then showed that source-bound evidence maintenance can accidentally trigger release-candidate validation and produce structurally incomplete failure evidence.
constraints: Fix the process at the schema/checker/archive/workflow boundaries; do not hand-edit evidence to bypass validators.
Keep WI-10 content implementation and version publication for later ordered Work Items.
Preserve explicit no-change rationale as a release-blocking state when a named path remains unmodified.
Use the existing Contract, Summary, archive Manifest, archive index, and CI evidence formats unless this Work Item formally extends and tests them.
intent.rationale: A single corrective process Work Item can make the discovered omission classes mechanically visible before another implementation Work Item is started, preventing the same drift from recurring in WI-10 and later release work.

rawUserRequest: 结束当前性能工单后，先补漏洞：强制把用户点名文件映射成实现/无变更理由；Summary schema 覆盖 hosted 证据结构；归档后自动重写或解析 traceability 路径，避免继续补遗漏时再次遗漏。每个工单仍须记录流程问题并完成完整 PR、合并、归档、关闭和分支清理流程。

rawRequestSource.summary: User explicitly required these three process vulnerabilities to be fixed before continuing to WI-10 or release.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the three discovered evidence and release-preflight omission classes mechanically detectable before WI-10 or release work continues.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The Summary schema rejects unknown or incomplete evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Work Item is archived and active paths become archive paths.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Traceability and digest checks resolve the final paths and reject stale references.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A governance/evidence PR changes source-bound release files without explicit release intent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Release preparation remains off; explicit release Work Items remain strict.
